scope: MTR physical station codes shared across lines
publicationPolicy: Historical publications establish spelling only. Current operational evidence is the MTR CSV. Web-indexed excerpts and third-party mirrors are disclosed; no claim of a full PDF download. Explicitly auto-translated-only sources are not accepted. Phase 3 uses reviewed existing Korean usage from named local Korean publisher KEIhk and human community railway references where an official Korean designation was unavailable. This is usage verification, not an MTR official Korean nomenclature claim.
